bracket_note: Configured Poisson means; actual finite-window arrival rates are reported separately.

answer_agreement.scope: Saved-response comparison by suite/source-line/ID; no numerical equivalence or causal performance attribution claimed.

package_scope: Summaries, all verified request timings, full quality outputs, frozen inputs and source; full AIPerf payload/transport exports remain at the indexed remote paths.
method_adjustments: The reused harness compares scheduler plans and observations in the same monotonic clock domain.
A symmetric 25ms scheduler tolerance is retained; observed timing lags are reported per point.
Isolated short-window backlog slopes are rechecked at 120 seconds before choosing a bracket.
If boundary confirmations disagree with exploration, refine.py bisects using 120-second observations.
